benchmarks.gate: screen expectancy must beat BOTH zero AND the control null; the DECIDER is the unexitable-dump rate
benchmarks.honest_prior: most memecoins are unexitable traps; enter only proven-exitable ones and leave before the exit closes
benchmarks.metric: EXPECTANCY (NET of toll) + the unexitable-dump rate (fraction of PASS trades ending UNEXITABLE_TIMEOUT)
benchmarks.null: control = same sizing/stop/target/exit on a deterministic sample of screen-REJECT coins

kill_switch.rule: HALT if, after n>=N_min resolved PASS trades, mean_R + 1.645*SE < 0 (forward expectancy significantly negative).
